proposed_from.topic: Honest minimax-width uniform confidence bands for a Hölder heterogeneous treatment-slope curve in a varying-coefficient partially linear model under fixed non-Gaussian treatment-noise separation, using the accepted contour-annihilator bank to remain valid with fixed nonzero conditional L1 treatment-code error and no outcome learner; prove primitive-condition simultaneous coverage and a matching all-band expected-width lower bound.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest uniform causal-band comparators use estimated regressions or balancing weights. The new theorem-level object is a uniformly localized contour factorization and all-band width frontier conditional on a fixed, persistently erroneous treatment code. The law class is procedure-independent, the conditional direct-error certificate is disclosed as a stronger novel input condition, and the code-error threshold is derived only after a quantitative noise-only contour bank. The proposal neither dominates nor is dominated by Ai--Huang--Zhang because the identifying structures and target classes differ in both directions.

seed_details.title: Fixed-error honest minimax-width spectral slope band
seed_details.anchor: LeeOkuiWhang2017, Sections 1--4 and Theorem 2; accepted prior proposal \(\texttt{stat\_sa\_plm\_cumulant\_converse}\)
seed_details.kernel: Construct a localized contour band with primitive-condition honesty and prove the matching all-band expected sup-width rate \((\log n/n)^{\beta/(2\beta+1)}\) under fixed conditional-\(L^1\) code error and no outcome learner.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The accepted fixed-contour empirical ratio becomes an indexed localized ratio whose denominator, linearization, and bootstrap approximation must hold uniformly over \(v\).
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for spectral annihilation plus CATE bands and for fixed treatment-code error plus uniform bands found no occupied target--method pair; the closest hits were outcome-based CATE bands and unrelated deconvolution bands.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from Lee--Okui--Whang plus Chernozhukov--Chetverikov--Kato after replacing their pseudo-outcome by the contour score.
seed_details.rebuttal: The replacement is the theorem: localization mixes unknown code shifts inside a complex ratio, so fixed error must cancel before coupling and the lower bound must range over all honest bands on the same spectral class.

seed_details.title: Weak-separation honest-band phase diagram
seed_details.anchor: ChenChristensen2018, Introduction and Theorem 4.1; accepted prior proposal open question on the local-to-Gaussian frontier
seed_details.kernel: Derive matching honest-band widths as a function of \(n\), \(\beta\), and \(\delta_n\), including the boundary below which shrinking width is impossible.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The fixed positive contour boundary modulus must be replaced by a sharp sequence-dependent modulus before bandwidth choice or Gaussian coupling is possible.
seed_details.destination_search: Chen--Christensen and Babii cover operator ill-posedness, while Andrews--Cheng covers weak identification; neither studies transform zeros with localized causal slopes and fixed code error.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This is merely NPIV ill-posedness with the singular value renamed as cumulant separation.
seed_details.rebuttal: The contour radius, boundary modulus, and selector failure co-move nonlinearly with \(\delta_n\); no existing operator result supplies that map or the Gaussian boundary experiment.

seed_details.title: If-and-only-if smoothness adaptation for spectral bands
seed_details.kernel: Characterize the exact distinguishability condition for honest adaptation over two Hölder slope classes after transport through the spectral experiment.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The nested-class testing modulus must be transported through a common multiscale contour bank whose cancellation and conditioning hold at every candidate resolution.
seed_details.destination_search: Hoffmann--Nickl and Chernozhukov--Chetverikov--Kato treat direct density experiments; no adaptive spectral causal band with persistent code error was found.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Hoffmann--Nickl's theorem transfers automatically because the slope is point identified.
seed_details.rebuttal: Point identification does not provide experiment equivalence; both testing lower bounds and multiscale achievability must survive the unknown transform and fixed code contamination.

seed_details.title: Location-adaptive integrated-width spectral band
seed_details.kernel: Optimize integrated expected width when modifier density and contour strength vary spatially, and certify strict improvement over constant-width bands.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Finite-dimensional confidence-set projection must become a variational bias-plus-Gaussian envelope with local spectral weights.
seed_details.destination_search: Freyberger--Rai optimize taut finite-dimensional bands and Zhang--Lee choose variable estimation bandwidths; neither solves the spectral causal variational problem.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This is routine variable-bandwidth smoothing followed by a weighted sup critical value.
seed_details.rebuttal: Simultaneous honesty couples local widths globally, so pointwise bandwidth minimization is not the variational optimum; nevertheless the exact optimizer is less directly supported than S1.

seed_details.title: Efficiency bound for a weighted average spectral slope
seed_details.kernel: Derive the semiparametric efficiency bound for \(\int w(v)\tau_0(v)\,dv\) in the fixed-error spectral model and determine whether a contour one-step estimator attains it.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The contour influence score must be projected onto the nuisance tangent space generated by the unknown treatment-noise law and code-shift distribution.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found efficiency theory for average linear regression functions and varying-coefficient parametric components, but not for transform-zero nuisance annihilation.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The accepted scalar root-\(n\) estimator already supplies the efficient influence function after weighting by \(w(V)\).
seed_details.rebuttal: Root-\(n\) regularity does not imply efficiency, and the unknown transform creates a nontrivial tangent projection; the target shift makes this less valuable for the requested curve band.

seed_details.title: Uniform Bahadur and multiplier limit for the localized contour estimator
seed_details.kernel: Prove a uniform Gaussian approximation and multiplier-bootstrap limit for the studentized localized contour-ratio process under primitive spectral conditions.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The empirical-process coupling must absorb a random pilot contour and a ratio denominator indexed jointly by location and complex contour position.
seed_details.destination_search: Uniform ratio-process and deconvolution-band papers were found, but no localized causal transform-zero process with fixed treatment-code contamination.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This is a direct application of generic Gaussian coupling once a Bahadur expansion is written.
seed_details.rebuttal: The expansion and uniform denominator control are non-generic, but as a standalone limit theorem this seed is strictly dominated by S1, which includes it and adds bias honesty and a converse.

seed_details.title: Spectral policy-learning regret under persistent code error
seed_details.anchor: LeeOkuiWhang2017, Introduction and CATE consumer discussion
seed_details.kernel: Use the spectral slope curve to choose \(\widehat\pi(v)=\mathbf 1\{\widehat\tau(v)\ge0\}\) and derive matching welfare regret under a Tsybakov margin condition despite fixed code error.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Uniform slope error must be converted into sign-policy regret, and the hard family must concentrate slope mass near zero while remaining spectrally separated.
seed_details.destination_search: Policy-learning searches found generic margin-regret and confidence-based policy methods, but not contour-identified policies under persistent nuisance-code error.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The regret rate follows mechanically from any sup-norm slope rate and a margin condition.
seed_details.rebuttal: The upper conversion is standard, so novelty would rest on the matched spectral hard family; this is credible but weaker than direct honest-band optimality.

seed_details.title: Permutation-inverted spectral slope band
seed_details.kernel: Under conditional symmetry of outcome noise, invert sign-flip tests of localized contour moments to obtain a finite-grid band and extend it to \(\mathcal I\) with a Hölder envelope.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: One must identify a symmetry group that leaves the composite nuisance transform invariant after plugging in the treatment code.
seed_details.destination_search: Conformal searches found counterfactual prediction intervals and individual-effect inference, not exact uniform bands for a conditional mean curve.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Conditional symmetry is a new strong assumption introduced only to obtain finite-sample calibration, and sign flips are not exact with an estimated contour denominator.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds without a new conditional randomization device; the seed is dropped rather than strengthened by an artificial assumption.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:honest-spectral-band / ass:admissible-external-code
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The band is conditional on a deterministic, externally certified code satisfying the conditional direct-L1 radius; it makes no auxiliary-sample learning claim.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform honesty and width hold over law-code pairs under the stated external-code certificate, not over codes learned from the inference sample.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:minimax-all-band-width / ass:hard-subclass-compatibility
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The converse is conditional on the displayed primitive constants admitting a nonempty asymmetric exact-code Gaussian-regression subclass.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The all-band lower bound holds for fixed constants with nonempty hard-triple compatibility set.
